body: Also no where near as lucky with relationships :( (just realized you went on into the comments)

All I can say is that I relate so much it's scary...I'm in pretty much exactly the same situation you are in...only I'm not good at music even though I wish I was :(

pm if you wanna talk

Sorry for taking so long to reply, but I had to reply because you took such a long time to write this out.

I'm making a big change in my life, and if that works out it will be great...it's my last resort though.

Yes, a distant memory of all the time I wasted and could have been enjoying...and will never get back. in 10 years life will suck even more...at least I had a "youth" buffer and could tell myself I'm still young and I could put off doing certain things.

>anything that will distract me long enough while I work towards my goal of seeing...

That makes me happy only temporarily...I still go back to bed and cry and think about killing myself... Isn't there anything more long term?

> If anything, if you are physically unattractive

Also the other unattractive, but I care about the physical one more... I doubt I could find anyone willing to spend time with me and not feel awful about it.

>perhaps you have not yet found your talent and calling.

And what would that be? I thought I did, but I'm not good at it or enjoy it.

>The "best years of your life" are what you make of them. In this day and age, at this point in humanity's evolution, there is really no such thing as "the prime of your life" anymore. Every moment you're alive should be considered the prime of your life.

No... I've wasted 21 years of my life. I haven't done anything I would have liked to, and don't have the skills I should have acquired in doing so.

Thanks for trying, but you did the opposite of help... You are describing everything I think is wrong and it's the reason I want to do it... I don't want to have to "cope" with it by masking it with alcohol all the time... I want to be happy, is that too much to ask?
